content.comment_body: I've attempted to install the [product_name] App on two separate Android devices, but it fails to work on both. I saw that Android versions below 4.0 aren't supported, yet my devices are running version 4.4.2. Is there something I'm overlooking? I really want to try working with [product_name] on a tablet, but so far I haven't been successful. Additionally, from the Google Play site, the app states for both devices, "This item cannot be installed in your device's country." Can someone clarify why this is the case? Thanks for your assistance.

analysis.insight_summary: The user cannot install the [product_name] App on two Android devices despite meeting the OS requirements. They encounter a country restriction error message and are frustrated because there is no explanation or guidance about these regional limits. The confusion over country-specific availability and the absence of alternative solutions is negatively affecting their experience with [product_name] on Android.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to be able to install and use the [product_name] App on any Android device that meets the technical requirements, regardless of their geographic location.
